m.e: I joined the trivia club this semester!

m.d: A tribune is an elected official in Ancient Rome.
A treasurer is a person who manages the assets of an organization.
If something is trendy, it is very fashionable.
m.e: I hate those trendy pre-wrinkled shirts.

m.d: A tract is a large area of land.
m.e: They bought a tract of farmland.

m.d: A tract is a system of organs or parts in the body that serve a specific function.
m.e: The digestive tract is responsible for breaking down food.

m.d: A tract is a short piece of writing, often on a religious or political subject.
m.e: He printed and handed out religious tracts in the town square.

m.d: A transvestite is a man that dresses in women's clothes or a woman that dresses in men's clothes.
The state of being tranquil.
The absence of disturbance; peacefulness.
The absence of stress; serenity.
Transgender is a gender for someone who was male but now identifies as female or who was female but identifies as male.
m.e: We had a long talk about issues around transgender.

m.d: Transgenders are people who are were male but now identify as female or female but now identify as male.
m.e: Transwomen (male-to-female transgenders) are more common than transmen.

m.d: A transgender person is someone who was male but now identifies as female or who was female but identifies as male.
m.e: The state's laws block transgender women from doing certain things.

m.d: If you trample on something, you crush it by walking on it.
m.e: The boy trampled the flowers.

m.d: If you trample someone, you treat them harshly.
A gym equipment that allows for people to run in place.
A trampoline is a device with a bouncy surface that people jump on for fun or exercise.
A trickster is a person who tricks or cheats another person.
m.e: The trickster cheated and gained all the money from everyone.

m.d: A transformer is a changer of voltage.
A trustee is a person to who is given control of a property and has a legal obligation to manage it for others.
A trombone is a musical instrument that uses the slide to play notes.
m.e: He picked up the trombone and started playing the national anthem.

m.d: If something is treasured, it is considered to be important.
Trickery is the practice of deception.
Tranquil is being free from emotional or mental disturbance.
Triage is an assessment or sorting something according to its quality and need.
If you triage something, you prioritize doing it.
A trapper is a person who traps animals. They often use the animals for their pelts or meat.
A transient is someone who works in a place for a short time only.
If something is transient, it only lasts for a short time.
A tremor is a shake or vibration.
A tremor is an earthquake.
If something tremors, it shakes or vibrates excessively and rapidly.
A tripod is a stand that supports cameras.
m.e: I put my camera on the tripod so that I can capture better pictures.

m.d: A tripod is a seat or table that has three legs.
Transparency is the quality of being transparent.
Tripe is a food that is the entrails (guts) of an animal.
m.e: Are you going to order that tripe for dinner?

m.d: If something is tripe, then it doesn't have any value.
m.e: Don't rent that movie, I have heard it was very tripe.

m.d: A trafficker is a person who buys and sells goods illegally.
If you traumatize someone, you injure them.
If you traumatize someone, you cause them to have a trauma.
Trimmings are small pieces that are trimmed off something.
m.e: The turkey trimmings can be used in macaroni and cheese.

m.d: Trimmings are decorations, especially for clothing.
A trinket is a small ornament or jewellery that has little value.
Triplet is a group or set of three.
m.e: When a mother gives birth to three babies at the same time, the babies are called triplets.

m.d: A tryout is test of the to see how good someone or something is at a task.
m.e: Jane is going to that tryout for the fall musical. I hope she makes it; she has a wonderful singing voice.
